title: Pure Frog
summary: Frog monsters with generic staples; the page's Spright and Paleozoic partners are left out. Ronintoadin, the second half of the page's core combo, is Forbidden in the TCG, so this list reaches Toadally Awesome another way: Swap Frog summons itself and sends Dupe Frog or Poison Draw Frog to the GY, then returns itself to the hand for a second Frog Normal Summon, and two Level 2 Aquas make Toadally Awesome. Rain of Frogs, the newest card, sends every non-Aqua monster to the GY while you control Toadally Awesome and sets itself again when destroyed. Toadally Awesome negates by sending a spare Frog from the hand and summons a Frog from the Deck in every Standby Phase.
main: Summons itself, sends a Level 2 Aqua to the GY, and grants an extra Frog Normal Summon.
Searches any Frog when it goes from the field to the GY; the only monster they can attack.
Level 2 Aqua that draws a card when it is sent from the field to the GY.
Tributes an Aqua to revive a Frog from the GY.
Limited. Tributes a monster to summon any Frog from the Deck.
Turns face-down and bounces their monsters when flipped.
Revives itself every Standby Phase while you have no Spells/Traps.
Newest card: with a 2000+ ATK Aqua, sends every non-Aqua monster to the GY; resets itself.
Destroys their Attack Position monsters when a Frog is attacked.
extra: Rank 2: negates and steals a card, summons a Frog every Standby Phase.
